identify: Confirm long narrow memory-module geometry and edge contacts.
Use Spike Glass evidence to distinguish RAM from other edge-card boards.
Record module type and visible contact/IC condition before altering it.

workflow.title: Grade whole module
workflow.instruction: Photograph and grade the RAM module intact before removing anything.

workflow.title: Sort by family
workflow.instruction: Keep server, desktop, laptop, older specialty, and unusually dense modules separated when identifiable.

workflow.title: Inspect edge contacts
workflow.instruction: Check whether the contact fingers are intact, worn, contaminated, or already trimmed.

workflow.title: Inspect IC population
workflow.instruction: Record chip count, package style, and board density for Board Sense reference comparison.

workflow.title: Compare sale paths
workflow.instruction: Compare intact RAM-board value with any buyer price for trimmed fingers or separated board fractions before cutting.

workflow.title: Mechanical separation only when justified
workflow.instruction: If the value comparison supports separation, keep finger material, remaining PCB, and removed hardware in distinct labeled fractions.

workflow.title: Time-value check
workflow.instruction: Use Worth My Time? to compare the added recovery value against labor minutes.

stop_conditions: buyer pays premium for intact RAM
refining_note: Precious-metal refining is a separate controlled process. RAM Lab provides identification, sorting, mechanical separation, and refinery-routing guidance rather than hazardous chemical recipes.
